description: DebugTool contract for bd-cv653.1.2 and bd-cv653.8.1: hermetic empty-session discovery plus named usage and missing-target errors before any adapter process is spawned.

cases.name: debug_sessions_reports_an_empty_registry
cases.description: sessions is a process-free happy path when no DAP session has been launched

cases.name: debug_launch_requires_a_program
cases.description: launch rejects a missing program as DAP_USAGE before resolving or spawning an adapter

cases.name: debug_launch_names_a_missing_target
cases.description: a nonexistent target fails as DAP_TARGET_MISSING before any platform debugger lookup
